extraction.method: Authenticated read-only browser comparison of the official Raft Web product; observations are behavior evidence, not copied source code.
extraction.location: Official Room/channel, direct-message, task-board, member, and Settings > Notifications surfaces at desktop and narrow viewports.

observed: The navigation rail, Room sidebar, conversation surface, and optional detail panel share one continuous divider system.
The Room sidebar and detail panel have bounded resize behavior; drag state does not introduce a second visual theme.
Opening another Room or direct message closes detail state that belongs to the previous conversation.
roomShell.scope: Composition and interaction evidence only. Exact dimensions remain fixture- and browser-acceptance assertions.

observed: Chat, Tasks, Files, and member/detail surfaces use a shared tab and toolbar visual language.
Empty states use a repeated icon, title, and supporting-copy composition rather than page-local placeholder text.
Hover, focus, disabled, loading, long-label, and narrow-screen states are part of the interaction contract.
roomTabsEmptyStatesControls.scope: No server-side behavior is inferred from visual state alone.

observed: The Task board uses five status columns with compact cards whose always-visible face prioritizes Task number, title, status and available actions.
Delivery or diagnostic detail does not permanently expand every card in the board; RAH-specific frozen evidence remains reachable through an explicit disclosure.
Moving or accepting a card is a visible command surface, but its business result must still be verified against canonical Task state.
roomTaskBoard.scope: Composition evidence only. RAH's immutable delivery evidence and Human acceptance rules are local-first adaptations, not inferred Raft server behavior.

observed: Raft exposes notification enablement, test notification, and workspace mute controls in Settings.
Visible settings behavior is evidence for control placement and states; RAH notification delivery remains owned by the local Human Inbox and browser permission boundary.
roomNotifications.scope: This observation does not claim parity with Raft iOS delivery or its private server implementation.
